meta.name: frame-flowchart-sticky
meta.description: SVG 曲线连接 + 便利贴节点 + 光标交互, 像白板 brainstorm

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在白板上绘制曲线连接和便利贴节点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在白板风格中快速绘制连接图和便签
copy.tagline_en: Draw curved connections and sticky notes on a whiteboard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly draw connection diagrams and sticky notes in a whiteboard style

howto.what: Claude 会把你的流程画成「白板 + 便利贴」风格的 1920×1080 单文件 HTML:便利贴当节点、SVG 贝塞尔曲线连接,配手写体文字和装饰性协作光标。
howto.when: 当你要做 onboarding 视频、运营流程说明或系统架构讲解,或直接提到「便利贴流程图」时,它按这套模板出图;节点文字来自你的真实流程内容。

say.text: 把我的用户 onboarding 流程画成便利贴流程图
这条流程的连接线改成虚线,表示条件分支
say.note: 调整实线/虚线与分支画法

say.text: 在第二个便利贴旁边加一个协作光标
say.note: 加入 SVG 箭头与名字标签

howto.what_en: Claude draws your process as a whiteboard-and-sticky-note 1920×1080 single-file HTML: sticky notes as nodes, SVG Bezier curves connecting them, handwritten fonts, decorative tape and a collaboration cursor.
howto.when_en: Use it when you need a flowchart for onboarding videos, ops process explainers or system architecture talks, or when you ask for a sticky-note flowchart; node text comes from your own content.

Make the connector lines dashed for the conditional branch
